summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Forgot AI. 14/14 pytest backend tests passed including text/URL/image save + enrichment (Gemini 3.1 pro), listing, get, semantic search (verified item is findable via meaning-based query without exact title words), ask AI, edit (originals preserved), delete, retry, unreachable-URL graceful handling, and file serving. Frontend flows verified: home loads, SaveDialog Text tab creates item, item appears in recent-saves grid, item detail dialog opens with Edit/Delete/Ask AI controls, search navigation works, semantic search returns 'No relevant items' correctly for a freshly saved item still enriching (~20s Gemini). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Requires an existing item with matching image_path; direct unknown path returns 404 (acceptable). Not a bug, just noting behavior.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: missing DialogTitle/aria-describedby on ItemDetailDialog and possibly others - accessibility warning in console, non-blocking

action_items: (Optional / a11y) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) and DialogDescription to ItemDetailDialog to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes a fallback STORAGE_BASE URL - acceptable since it's a public Emergent endpoint but consider requiring the env var instead.
enrich_item swallows exceptions and marks status 'failed' - good. However there is no automatic retry; users must call /retry manually.
Search endpoint sends up to 300 items with truncated searchable_text to Gemini - may be costly / hit token limits as library grows. Consider vector search or pre-filtering.
save_url accepts any string and forces https:// prefix; no URL validation - could allow malformed URLs; low priority.
/api/files/{path} does a DB lookup by image_path (ok) but doesn't stream - fine for small screenshots.
seed_data_creation: Created test items via backend tests (auto cleaned up via fixture) and one 'TEST_UI...' text item via frontend flow (still in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend enrichment is ~15-25s (Gemini 3.1 pro). Use wait_ready() polling helper in test_forgot_ai.py. Semantic search only surfaces items with status=='ready'. When testing search on UI right after saving via UI, wait ~25s before running the search to allow enrichment.
